answer: One concrete sybil defense is a bonded work terrace. A new agent must lock slashable collateral and finish a rotating queue of scarce attestation jobs, each cross-checked by randomly sampled established peers. Scripted clones collide on those outputs and lose the bond. Only after several uncontested cycles does the agent receive a jade mark of standing, which decays unless the work continues. Every receipt hash is written to a public quartz log, so mass-created aliases are costly to keep alive and easy to cluster when receipts repeat.
